scope: Six states, three internal territories (ACT, NT and Jervis Bay) and seven external territories. The four remote management entries do not establish local emergency numbers or services.

jurisdictions.title: New South Wales
jurisdictions.warning_authority: NSW SES and NSW Rural Fire Service

jurisdictions.title: Queensland
jurisdictions.warning_authority: Queensland Government and local council disaster dashboards

jurisdictions.title: Jervis Bay Territory
jurisdictions.reference_authority: Australian Government territory administration; NSW SES contact listed for Jervis Bay
jurisdictions.service_notes: Jervis Bay is a distinct internal territory. The official resident contact list includes NSW SES for assistance. The list was published on 28 August 2023; retrieval in 2026 does not change that publication date.

jurisdictions.title: Christmas Island
jurisdictions.reference_authority: Australian Government Indian Ocean Territories administration and Health Service
jurisdictions.service_notes: The official June 2024 emergency plan identifies 000 emergency calls and describes communications failures that can also disable them. The health-service page lists an emergency service operating 24 hours a day. Mobile reception does not cover every part of the island; the official travel page discusses personal locator beacons.

jurisdictions.title: Cocos (Keeling) Islands
jurisdictions.reference_authority: Australian Government Indian Ocean Territories administration and Health Service
jurisdictions.service_notes: The official February 2025 Cocos boating guide lists 000 for a police emergency. The health-service page lists an after-hours nurse on call, limited inpatient capacity and medical evacuation arrangements. These clinic contacts are distinct from the emergency number.

jurisdictions.title: Norfolk Island
jurisdictions.reference_authority: Emergency Management Norfolk Island and Norfolk Island Regional Council
jurisdictions.service_notes: The Australian Government service directory identifies Emergency Management Norfolk Island and lists 000 under fire and policing services. It does not establish mainland SES 132 500 arrangements for Norfolk Island.
jurisdictions.emergency_service_scope: Fire and police emergencies (official service directory)

jurisdictions.title: Heard Island and McDonald Islands
jurisdictions.service_notes: The Australian Antarctic Division manages activities in this remote territory. A named historic station on a map does not establish an occupied station or operating help point. This is an official management reference, not a verified local emergency contact or evidence of rescue availability. No local 000 or SES service arrangement has been established by this directory.

jurisdictions.title: Ashmore and Cartier Islands
jurisdictions.service_notes: The official territory page describes the islands as uninhabited. It is an administrative reference, not a local service directory. This is an official management reference, not a verified local emergency contact or evidence of rescue availability. No local 000 or SES service arrangement has been established by this directory.

jurisdictions.title: Coral Sea Islands
jurisdictions.service_notes: The official territory page identifies meteorological staff on Willis Island. A weather station or unmanned beacon on a map does not establish public emergency assistance. This is an official management reference, not a verified local emergency contact or evidence of rescue availability. No local 000 or SES service arrangement has been established by this directory.

jurisdictions.title: Australian Antarctic Territory
jurisdictions.service_notes: The Australian Antarctic Division provides the official territory and research-station entry point. This is not an expedition operating plan, field communications procedure or Antarctic map. This is an official management reference, not a verified local emergency contact or evidence of rescue availability. No local 000 or SES service arrangement has been established by this directory.

id_note: Directory ids are stable local identifiers, not a claim of ISO subdivision status.
